about: Frozen list of tests that read studio source (src/**/*.ts|tsx|mjs|js) as text; enforced by scripts/check-test-style.ts. Entries may only be removed, never added: rewrite a listed test to check behaviour (import the module, use a helper in tests/helpers/, or drive the app), then delete its line. The check fails when a listed file stops reading source, and when a file is added compared with the merge base.
